annotations.text: Today + Tutor, evolved from the current paper/ink look. Token values are lifted from apps/web/src/styles.css. Sample clinical content is illustrative; PMIDs and DOIs are placeholders.

Nine classes the pages already emit have no CSS today (badges, support-*, tags, provenance, quote, prompt, disclosure-panel, attempt, point). This pass gives each a style; the Tokens page collects them.
Section headings become small uppercase labels (sans 12/600) so the serif content leads. Card headings stay sans 17/600.
After a grade the textarea becomes a read-only copy of the answer and the actions collapse to Next question. Today the textarea stays editable under the result.
Model unavailable: nothing is dressed as a grade. The failure line is red text, not a card; the self-assessment offer is its own card and its outcome carries a person mark, never a check.
Proposed additions to :root — accent-tint, accent-line, fail-bg, fail-line, tag-bg — with dark-mode counterparts. Everything else is already in styles.css.
Decided 2026-09-17: one reading column at every width (max 46rem), accept the scroll. Desktop differs only in the header, where the nav sits beside the wordmark.
Decided: after a grade the question card collapses to prompt + support + a read-only copy of the answer, so the feedback sits higher on a phone. Next question moves below the reference.
Sources is the intake surface, so it is denser: 44px rows, 12px sans metadata, a 56px coverage mini-bar per pile, files as compact rows with a type chip. One pile is shown expanded.

Improvement Map as a graph (Obsidian-style): nodes are topics, size = open flags, colour = specialty cluster, edges = topics sharing a source pile or learning point. Drag, tap to select, pinch/scroll to zoom. Needs a `links` field the API does not return yet — see DESIGN.md.
Model: two states shown. The one-time code lives in component state only; the verification link is a link, never auto-opened.
